bible_quanes.question: What kind of new king arose over Egypt?
bible_quanes.answer: A king which knew not Joseph
bible_quanes.explanation: He feared the growing number of Israelites.

bible_quanes.question: Which two store cities did the Israelites build for Pharaoh?
bible_quanes.explanation: They were forced labourers under taskmasters.

bible_quanes.question: Name the two Hebrew midwives.
bible_quanes.explanation: Pharaoh ordered them to kill the Hebrew baby boys.

bible_quanes.question: What did Pharaoh command concerning every Hebrew son born?
bible_quanes.answer: That he be cast into the river
bible_quanes.explanation: The daughters were to be kept alive.

bible_quanes.question: What happened to the children of Israel in Egypt after Joseph's generation died?
bible_quanes.answer: They were fruitful, increased abundantly, multiplied and waxed exceeding mighty
bible_quanes.explanation: The land was filled with them.

bible_quanes.question: What happened the more the Egyptians afflicted the Israelites?
bible_quanes.answer: The more they multiplied and grew
bible_quanes.explanation: The Egyptians came to dread them.

bible_quanes.question: Why did the midwives not obey Pharaoh?
bible_quanes.explanation: They let the boys live.

bible_quanes.question: What explanation did the midwives give Pharaoh?
bible_quanes.answer: The Hebrew women are lively and are delivered ere the midwives come in unto them
bible_quanes.explanation: God dealt well with the midwives.

bible_quanes.question: How many descendants of Jacob had come into Egypt?
bible_quanes.explanation: Joseph was already in Egypt.

bible_quanes.question: How did God reward the midwives?
bible_quanes.explanation: Because they feared God.

bible_quanes.question: In what did Moses' mother hide him?
bible_quanes.answer: An ark of bulrushes daubed with slime and with pitch
bible_quanes.explanation: She laid it in the reeds by the river's bank.

bible_quanes.question: Who found baby Moses?
bible_quanes.explanation: She had come down to bathe at the river.

bible_quanes.question: Why was he named Moses?
bible_quanes.answer: Because she drew him out of the water
bible_quanes.explanation: Pharaoh's daughter gave him the name.

bible_quanes.question: Where did Moses flee when Pharaoh sought to kill him?
bible_quanes.explanation: He sat down by a well there.

bible_quanes.question: Who watched from a distance to see what would happen to baby Moses?
bible_quanes.explanation: She stood afar off.

bible_quanes.question: Who was hired to nurse baby Moses?
bible_quanes.explanation: Pharaoh's daughter paid her wages.

bible_quanes.question: What did Moses do to the Egyptian who was beating a Hebrew?
bible_quanes.answer: Slew him and hid him in the sand
bible_quanes.explanation: He looked this way and that way first.

bible_quanes.question: Whom did Moses marry in Midian?
bible_quanes.explanation: She was the daughter of the priest of Midian.

bible_quanes.question: What did Moses name his first son, and why?
bible_quanes.answer: Gershom, for he said, I have been a stranger in a strange land
bible_quanes.explanation: The name relates to being a sojourner.

bible_quanes.question: What did God remember when He heard Israel's groaning?
bible_quanes.answer: His covenant with Abraham, Isaac and Jacob
bible_quanes.explanation: God looked on them and acknowledged them.

bible_quanes.question: What did God appear as to Moses in Midian?
bible_quanes.answer: A flame of fire out of the midst of a bush
bible_quanes.explanation: The bush burned but was not consumed, and God called Moses from it.

bible_quanes.question: When Moses asked for the name of God, what answer did he get?
bible_quanes.explanation: God revealed His divine name to Moses at the burning bush.

bible_quanes.question: What was Moses doing when God appeared to him?
bible_quanes.answer: He kept the flock of Jethro his father in law
bible_quanes.explanation: He had led the flock to Horeb, the mountain of God.

bible_quanes.question: What did God tell Moses to take off?
bible_quanes.explanation: The place where he stood was holy ground.

bible_quanes.question: How did God describe the land He would give Israel?
bible_quanes.answer: A land flowing with milk and honey
bible_quanes.explanation: A good and large land.

bible_quanes.question: To whom did God send Moses?
bible_quanes.explanation: To bring the children of Israel out of Egypt.

bible_quanes.question: How did God identify Himself to Moses at the bush?
bible_quanes.answer: The God of Abraham, Isaac and Jacob
bible_quanes.explanation: Moses hid his face, afraid to look at God.

bible_quanes.question: What was Moses' first objection to God's call?
bible_quanes.answer: "Who am I that I should go to Pharaoh?"
bible_quanes.explanation: He felt inadequate for the task.

bible_quanes.question: What sign did God give Moses that He had sent him?
bible_quanes.answer: When thou hast brought forth the people out of Egypt, ye shall serve God upon this mountain
bible_quanes.explanation: God promised to be with him.

bible_quanes.question: What was the mountain of God called in Exodus 3?
bible_quanes.explanation: It is also known as Sinai.

bible_quanes.question: What would the Israelite women ask of their Egyptian neighbours?
bible_quanes.answer: Jewels of silver, jewels of gold, and raiment
bible_quanes.explanation: In this way they would plunder the Egyptians.

bible_quanes.question: What did God say was His name for ever?
bible_quanes.answer: The LORD God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, Isaac and Jacob
bible_quanes.explanation: This is His memorial to all generations.

bible_quanes.question: What did Moses' rod become when he threw it on the ground?
bible_quanes.explanation: Moses fled from it.

bible_quanes.question: What happened to Moses' hand when he put it into his bosom?
bible_quanes.explanation: This was the second sign.

bible_quanes.question: Who was appointed to speak for Moses?
bible_quanes.explanation: Aaron was already coming to meet him.

bible_quanes.question: Where did Aaron meet Moses?
bible_quanes.explanation: He kissed him.

bible_quanes.question: What was the third sign God gave Moses?
bible_quanes.answer: Water of the river shall become blood upon the dry land
bible_quanes.explanation: For if they did not believe the first two signs.

bible_quanes.question: What did Moses say about his speech?
bible_quanes.answer: He was slow of speech and slow of tongue
bible_quanes.explanation: He said he was not eloquent.

bible_quanes.question: What did God answer about who makes man's mouth?
bible_quanes.explanation: He promised to teach Moses what to say.

bible_quanes.question: What did God tell Moses to call Israel before Pharaoh?
bible_quanes.explanation: "Let My son go that he may serve Me."

bible_quanes.question: Who circumcised her son with a sharp stone?
bible_quanes.explanation: This happened at the encampment on the way to Egypt.

bible_quanes.question: How did the people respond when they saw the signs?
bible_quanes.answer: They believed, bowed their heads and worshipped
bible_quanes.explanation: They heard that the LORD had visited them.

bible_quanes.question: What did Moses and Aaron say to Pharaoh?
bible_quanes.answer: "Let My people go, that they may hold a feast to Me in the wilderness"
bible_quanes.explanation: They spoke in the name of the LORD God of Israel.

bible_quanes.question: How did Pharaoh answer?
bible_quanes.answer: "Who is the LORD, that I should obey His voice?"
bible_quanes.explanation: He refused to let Israel go.

bible_quanes.question: What did Pharaoh stop giving the Israelites?
bible_quanes.explanation: They had to gather straw themselves.

bible_quanes.question: What did Pharaoh accuse the people of being?
bible_quanes.explanation: He increased their burden.

bible_quanes.question: Who were beaten when the brick quota was not met?
bible_quanes.answer: The officers of the children of Israel set over them
bible_quanes.explanation: The taskmasters beat them.

bible_quanes.question: What did the officers say to Moses and Aaron?
bible_quanes.answer: Ye have made our savour to be abhorred in the eyes of Pharaoh
bible_quanes.explanation: They blamed Moses and Aaron.

bible_quanes.question: What did Moses ask the LORD after the burdens increased?
bible_quanes.answer: "Wherefore hast thou so evil entreated this people?"
bible_quanes.explanation: Moses was discouraged.

bible_quanes.question: What did Moses complain God had not yet done?
bible_quanes.explanation: Things had worsened since he spoke to Pharaoh.

bible_quanes.question: What were the Israelites still required to produce?
bible_quanes.explanation: Even without straw provided.

bible_quanes.question: What did the people gather instead of straw?
bible_quanes.explanation: They were scattered throughout all Egypt.

bible_quanes.question: What did God promise to do with an outstretched arm?
bible_quanes.explanation: With great judgments.

bible_quanes.question: By what name had God appeared to Abraham, Isaac and Jacob?
bible_quanes.explanation: By His name LORD (YHWH) He was not known to them.

bible_quanes.question: Who were Moses' parents?
bible_quanes.explanation: Jochebed was Amram's father's sister.

bible_quanes.question: How did Moses describe his lips?
bible_quanes.explanation: He felt unfit to speak to Pharaoh.

bible_quanes.question: What did God promise in Exodus 6:7?
bible_quanes.answer: "I will take you as My people, and I will be your God"
bible_quanes.explanation: They would know that He is the LORD.

bible_quanes.question: Why did the Israelites not listen to Moses?
bible_quanes.answer: For anguish of spirit, and for cruel bondage
bible_quanes.explanation: They were too discouraged to listen.

bible_quanes.question: Who was Aaron's wife?
bible_quanes.explanation: She was the daughter of Amminadab.

bible_quanes.question: From which son of Jacob were Moses and Aaron descended?
bible_quanes.explanation: Levi lived 137 years.

bible_quanes.question: Name Aaron's four sons.
bible_quanes.explanation: Elisheba bore them to Aaron.

bible_quanes.question: Who was Eleazar's son?
bible_quanes.explanation: His mother was a daughter of Putiel.

bible_quanes.question: What did God say He had made Moses to Pharaoh?
bible_quanes.explanation: Aaron would be his prophet.

bible_quanes.question: What did Aaron's rod become before Pharaoh?
bible_quanes.explanation: Pharaoh's magicians did the same.

bible_quanes.question: What happened to the magicians' rods?
bible_quanes.explanation: Still Pharaoh's heart grew hard.

bible_quanes.question: What was the first plague?
bible_quanes.answer: The water of the river turned to blood
bible_quanes.explanation: Aaron struck the waters with the rod.

bible_quanes.question: How old were Moses and Aaron when they spoke to Pharaoh?
bible_quanes.answer: Moses was fourscore and Aaron fourscore and three years old
bible_quanes.explanation: They did as the Lord commanded.

bible_quanes.question: Whom did Pharaoh call to imitate Aaron's sign?
bible_quanes.answer: The wise men, sorcerers and magicians
bible_quanes.explanation: They did the same with their enchantments.

bible_quanes.question: What happened to the fish in the river?
bible_quanes.answer: They died, and the river stank
bible_quanes.explanation: The Egyptians could not drink its water.

bible_quanes.question: How did the Egyptians get drinking water during the first plague?
bible_quanes.answer: They digged round about the river for water to drink
bible_quanes.explanation: They could not drink the river water.

bible_quanes.question: How many days passed after the LORD struck the river?
bible_quanes.explanation: Then the next plague was announced.

bible_quanes.question: What did God say He would do to Pharaoh's heart?
bible_quanes.explanation: To multiply His signs and wonders in Egypt.

bible_quanes.question: What was the second plague?
bible_quanes.explanation: They came up and covered the land of Egypt.

bible_quanes.question: What was the third plague?
bible_quanes.explanation: The dust of the land became lice.

bible_quanes.question: What was the fourth plague?
bible_quanes.explanation: The land was corrupted by them.

bible_quanes.question: Which land was spared the swarms of flies?
bible_quanes.explanation: Where God's people dwelt.

bible_quanes.question: What did the magicians say after the plague of lice?
bible_quanes.explanation: They could not reproduce it.

bible_quanes.question: What did Pharaoh ask of Moses during the plague of frogs?
bible_quanes.answer: "Intreat the LORD, that he may take away the frogs"
bible_quanes.explanation: He promised to let the people go.

bible_quanes.question: When did Pharaoh ask for the frogs to be removed?
bible_quanes.explanation: So he would know there is no one like the LORD.

bible_quanes.question: What did Pharaoh do when there was relief from the frogs?
bible_quanes.explanation: He did not heed Moses and Aaron.

bible_quanes.question: Why did Moses say Israel could not sacrifice within Egypt?
bible_quanes.answer: We shall sacrifice the abomination of the Egyptians, and will they not stone us?
bible_quanes.explanation: The Egyptians might stone them.

bible_quanes.question: What condition did Pharaoh set during the plague of flies?
bible_quanes.answer: Ye shall not go very far away
bible_quanes.explanation: He also asked Moses to pray for him.

bible_quanes.question: What was the fifth plague?
bible_quanes.answer: A very grievous murrain upon the cattle
bible_quanes.explanation: It struck the animals in the field.

bible_quanes.question: What was the sixth plague?
bible_quanes.answer: Boils breaking out on man and beast
bible_quanes.explanation: Moses scattered ashes from the furnace toward heaven.

bible_quanes.question: What was the seventh plague?
bible_quanes.answer: Thunder and hail, and the fire ran along upon the ground
bible_quanes.explanation: Accompanied by thunder.

bible_quanes.question: Where was there no hail?
bible_quanes.explanation: Where the children of Israel were.

bible_quanes.question: How much of Israel's cattle died in the fifth plague?
bible_quanes.explanation: All the cattle of Egypt died.

bible_quanes.question: Why could the magicians not stand before Moses?
bible_quanes.explanation: The boils were on the magicians too.

bible_quanes.question: Why did God say He had raised Pharaoh up?
bible_quanes.answer: To shew in him His power, that His name may be declared throughout all the earth
bible_quanes.explanation: Paul quotes this in Romans 9:17.

bible_quanes.question: What did those who feared the word of the LORD do before the hail?
bible_quanes.answer: Made his servants and his cattle flee into the houses
bible_quanes.explanation: They were spared.

bible_quanes.question: Which crops did the hail destroy, and which survived?
bible_quanes.answer: The flax and the barley were smitten; the wheat and the rie were not
bible_quanes.explanation: The wheat and spelt were late crops.

bible_quanes.question: What did Pharaoh confess after the hail?
bible_quanes.answer: "I have sinned; the LORD is righteous, and my people and I are wicked"
bible_quanes.explanation: He later hardened his heart again.

bible_quanes.question: What was the eighth plague?
bible_quanes.explanation: They covered the face of the whole earth.

bible_quanes.question: What was the ninth plague?
bible_quanes.explanation: It lasted three days.

bible_quanes.question: Who had light in their dwellings during the darkness?
bible_quanes.explanation: The Egyptians could not see one another.

bible_quanes.question: What took the locusts away?
bible_quanes.explanation: It drove them into the Red Sea.

bible_quanes.question: What did Pharaoh's servants urge him to do?
bible_quanes.answer: Let the men go, for Egypt was destroyed
bible_quanes.explanation: They feared ruin.

bible_quanes.question: Whom did Pharaoh offer to let go before the locusts?
bible_quanes.explanation: Not the little ones.

bible_quanes.question: What brought the locusts?
bible_quanes.explanation: It blew all that day and night.

bible_quanes.question: What did Pharaoh want kept back after the darkness?
bible_quanes.explanation: The little ones could go.

bible_quanes.question: What did Moses insist about their cattle?
bible_quanes.answer: Not a hoof would be left behind
bible_quanes.explanation: They needed them to worship the LORD.

bible_quanes.question: What did Pharaoh threaten after the darkness?
bible_quanes.answer: In the day Moses saw his face again, he would die
bible_quanes.explanation: Moses said he would not see his face again.

bible_quanes.question: How many more plagues did God tell Moses would come?
bible_quanes.explanation: Afterwards Pharaoh would let them go.

bible_quanes.question: What would the final plague be?
bible_quanes.answer: All the firstborn in the land of Egypt shall die
bible_quanes.explanation: From Pharaoh's firstborn to the maidservant's.

bible_quanes.question: What animal would not even move its tongue against Israel?
bible_quanes.explanation: Showing God's distinction between Egypt and Israel.

bible_quanes.question: What would be heard throughout all Egypt?
bible_quanes.explanation: Such as had never been nor would be again.

bible_quanes.question: What were the people to ask of their neighbours?
bible_quanes.answer: Jewels of silver and jewels of gold
bible_quanes.explanation: The Lord gave them favour.

bible_quanes.question: How was Moses regarded in Egypt?
bible_quanes.explanation: In the sight of Pharaoh's servants and the people.

bible_quanes.question: At what time would the LORD go out into Egypt?
bible_quanes.explanation: To strike the firstborn.

bible_quanes.question: In what mood did Moses leave Pharaoh?
bible_quanes.explanation: After announcing the final plague.

bible_quanes.question: Besides people, whose firstborn would die?
bible_quanes.explanation: The livestock too.

bible_quanes.question: Why did Pharaoh not let Israel go despite all the wonders?
bible_quanes.explanation: This summarises the plague narratives.

bible_quanes.question: How many years did the Jews live in Egypt?
bible_quanes.explanation: The dwelling of the Israelites in Egypt was 430 years.

bible_quanes.question: At what hour did the LORD smite all the firstborn in the land of Egypt?
bible_quanes.explanation: The tenth and final plague fell at midnight, from the firstborn of Pharaoh to the firstborn of the captive in the dungeon.

bible_quanes.question: How many people left Egypt with Moses?
bible_quanes.answer: About six hundred thousand on foot that were men, beside children
bible_quanes.explanation: A mixed crowd also went up with them, along with cattle.

bible_quanes.question: On which day of the month was each household to take a lamb?
bible_quanes.explanation: Of the first month.

bible_quanes.question: Where was the lamb's blood to be put?
bible_quanes.answer: On the two side posts and the upper door post
bible_quanes.explanation: Of the houses where it was eaten.

bible_quanes.question: What would God do when He saw the blood?
bible_quanes.explanation: No plague would destroy them.

bible_quanes.question: For how many days was unleavened bread eaten?
bible_quanes.explanation: The Feast of Unleavened Bread.

bible_quanes.question: Which month was to become the first month of the year?
bible_quanes.answer: This month, the beginning of months
bible_quanes.explanation: It marked a new beginning for Israel.

bible_quanes.question: What kind of lamb was required for the Passover?
bible_quanes.answer: A male of the first year without blemish
bible_quanes.explanation: From the sheep or the goats.

bible_quanes.question: How were the Israelites to eat the Passover?
bible_quanes.answer: With loins girded, shoes on your feet, staff in your hand, in haste
bible_quanes.explanation: Ready to leave.

bible_quanes.question: What was not to be broken in the Passover lamb?
bible_quanes.explanation: John 19:36 applies this to Jesus.

bible_quanes.question: What plant was used to apply the blood?
bible_quanes.explanation: It was dipped in the blood in the basin.

bible_quanes.question: What were parents to answer when children asked about the Passover?
bible_quanes.answer: It is the sacrifice of the LORD's Passover, who passed over the houses of Israel
bible_quanes.explanation: It was a teaching ceremony.

bible_quanes.question: How did God shew the way to the Israelites in the wilderness?
bible_quanes.answer: A pillar of cloud by day and a pillar of fire by night
bible_quanes.explanation: The LORD went ahead of them in a pillar of cloud by day and fire by night.

bible_quanes.question: What did God tell Moses to consecrate to Him?
bible_quanes.explanation: Of both man and beast.

bible_quanes.question: Whose bones did Moses take with him?
bible_quanes.explanation: Joseph had made the Israelites swear to do so.

bible_quanes.question: Why did God not lead Israel by the way of the Philistines?
bible_quanes.answer: Lest the people repent when they see war and return to Egypt
bible_quanes.explanation: Even though that way was nearer.

bible_quanes.question: By which way did God lead the people?
bible_quanes.answer: The way of the wilderness of the Red Sea
bible_quanes.explanation: A longer route.

bible_quanes.question: In which month did Israel go out of Egypt?
bible_quanes.explanation: A spring month.

bible_quanes.question: What would the feast be on their hand?
bible_quanes.explanation: And a memorial between their eyes.

bible_quanes.question: What was to be done with a firstborn ass?
bible_quanes.answer: Redeem it with a lamb, or break its neck
bible_quanes.explanation: Firstborn sons were to be redeemed.

bible_quanes.question: Did the pillars of cloud and fire ever leave the people?
bible_quanes.answer: No; He took not away the pillar of cloud by day nor the pillar of fire by night
bible_quanes.explanation: They guided Israel continually.

bible_quanes.question: Where did Israel camp at the edge of the wilderness?
bible_quanes.explanation: After setting out from Succoth.

bible_quanes.question: In what manner did Israel go up out of Egypt?
bible_quanes.explanation: They left prepared.

bible_quanes.question: What did Moses stretch out over the sea?
bible_quanes.explanation: The LORD drove the sea back with a strong east wind.

bible_quanes.question: How did Israel cross the sea?
bible_quanes.answer: Upon the dry ground, the waters a wall on their right hand and on their left
bible_quanes.explanation: On their right and left.

bible_quanes.question: What happened to Pharaoh's army?
bible_quanes.answer: The waters covered them; not one remained
bible_quanes.explanation: The sea returned to its full depth.

bible_quanes.question: What did Moses tell the people at the sea?
bible_quanes.answer: Do not be afraid; stand still and see the salvation of the LORD
bible_quanes.explanation: The Egyptians they saw that day they would never see again.

bible_quanes.question: How many choice chariots did Pharaoh take?
bible_quanes.explanation: Along with all the chariots of Egypt.

bible_quanes.question: What did the people complain to Moses?
bible_quanes.answer: Because there were no graves in Egypt, hast thou taken us away to die in the wilderness?
bible_quanes.explanation: They were terrified.

bible_quanes.question: What moved from before Israel to behind them?
bible_quanes.answer: The Angel of God and the pillar of cloud
bible_quanes.explanation: It came between the two camps.

bible_quanes.question: What happened to the Egyptian chariot wheels?
bible_quanes.answer: The LORD took off their chariot wheels, so they drave them heavily
bible_quanes.explanation: They drove with difficulty.

bible_quanes.question: What did Moses say the LORD would do for them?
bible_quanes.answer: The LORD shall fight for you, and ye shall hold your peace
bible_quanes.explanation: They were to trust and be still.

bible_quanes.question: How did Israel respond after seeing God's great work?
bible_quanes.answer: The people feared the LORD and believed the LORD and His servant Moses
bible_quanes.explanation: Their faith was strengthened.

bible_quanes.question: What did Moses and the Israelites do after crossing the sea?
bible_quanes.answer: Sang a song to the LORD
bible_quanes.explanation: Known as the Song of Moses.

bible_quanes.question: Who took a timbrel and led the women in dancing?
bible_quanes.explanation: She was Aaron's sister.

bible_quanes.question: Why was the place called Marah?
bible_quanes.explanation: Marah means 'bitter'.

bible_quanes.question: What did Israel find at Elim?
bible_quanes.answer: Twelve wells of water and threescore and ten palm trees
bible_quanes.explanation: They camped there by the waters.

bible_quanes.question: What made the waters of Marah sweet?
bible_quanes.answer: A tree cast into the water
bible_quanes.explanation: The LORD shewed Moses the tree.

bible_quanes.question: How did God describe Himself at Marah?
bible_quanes.explanation: Jehovah Rapha.

bible_quanes.question: What does the Song of Moses call the LORD?
bible_quanes.explanation: "The LORD is His name."

bible_quanes.question: How long did the people go without water in the Wilderness of Shur?
bible_quanes.explanation: Then they came to Marah.

bible_quanes.question: Complete the line: "Who is like thee, glorious in ...?"
bible_quanes.explanation: Fearful in praises, doing wonders.

bible_quanes.question: Complete: "The LORD is my strength and ..."
bible_quanes.answer: Song, and He has become my salvation
bible_quanes.explanation: From the Song of Moses.

bible_quanes.question: What did God rain down from heaven?
bible_quanes.explanation: To test whether they would walk in His law.

bible_quanes.question: What came up in the evening and covered the camp?
bible_quanes.explanation: In the morning dew lay around the camp.

bible_quanes.question: What did manna taste like?
bible_quanes.explanation: It was white like coriander seed.

bible_quanes.question: For how long did Israel eat manna?
bible_quanes.explanation: Until they came to the border of Canaan.

bible_quanes.question: How much manna was gathered for each person?
bible_quanes.explanation: According to the number of people.

bible_quanes.question: What happened to manna kept until morning?
bible_quanes.explanation: Except on the Sabbath.

bible_quanes.question: How much manna was gathered on the sixth day?
bible_quanes.explanation: For the Sabbath rest.

bible_quanes.question: What was to be kept for future generations?
bible_quanes.answer: An omer of manna in a pot
bible_quanes.explanation: Laid up before the LORD.

bible_quanes.question: What did the Israelites say when they saw the manna?
bible_quanes.answer: "It is manna": for they wist not what it was
bible_quanes.explanation: The people did not know what it was.

bible_quanes.question: How much is an omer?
bible_quanes.answer: The tenth part of an ephah
bible_quanes.explanation: A unit of measure.

bible_quanes.question: What did Moses strike to get water at Horeb?
bible_quanes.explanation: Water came out for the people to drink.

bible_quanes.question: Who fought against Israel at Rephidim?
bible_quanes.explanation: The Amalekites attacked Israel.

bible_quanes.question: What happened when Moses held up his hands?
bible_quanes.explanation: When he let them down, Amalek prevailed.

bible_quanes.question: Who led Israel's fighting men against Amalek?
bible_quanes.explanation: Moses chose him.

bible_quanes.question: Who held up Moses' hands?
bible_quanes.explanation: One on each side, until the sun went down.

bible_quanes.question: What names were given to the place where the people quarreled over water?
bible_quanes.explanation: Meaning 'testing' and 'contention'.

bible_quanes.question: What did God say He would blot out?
bible_quanes.explanation: From under heaven.

bible_quanes.question: What did Moses name the altar he built?
bible_quanes.explanation: To commemorate the victory.

bible_quanes.question: On what did Moses sit when his hands grew heavy?
bible_quanes.explanation: They put it under him.

bible_quanes.question: What did Moses ask when the people contended with him?
bible_quanes.explanation: They had no water to drink.

bible_quanes.question: Who was Moses' father-in-law, the priest of Midian?
bible_quanes.explanation: He heard all God had done for Israel.

bible_quanes.question: What did Moses do from morning until evening?
bible_quanes.explanation: The people stood around him.

bible_quanes.question: What did Jethro say about Moses' way of judging?
bible_quanes.answer: "The thing that you do is not good"
bible_quanes.explanation: Moses would wear himself out.

bible_quanes.question: What kind of men did Jethro advise appointing?
bible_quanes.answer: Able men who fear God, men of truth, hating covetousness
bible_quanes.explanation: They would be rulers over the people.

bible_quanes.question: Name Moses' two sons.
bible_quanes.explanation: Eliezer means 'my God is help'.

bible_quanes.question: What did Jethro declare about the LORD?
bible_quanes.answer: He is greater than all the gods
bible_quanes.explanation: He rejoiced at Israel's deliverance.

bible_quanes.question: Over what group sizes were the rulers set?
bible_quanes.explanation: A system of delegation.

bible_quanes.question: Which cases were still to be brought to Moses?
bible_quanes.explanation: The rulers judged the small matters.

bible_quanes.question: Who ate bread with Jethro before God?
bible_quanes.answer: Aaron and all the elders of Israel
bible_quanes.explanation: After Jethro offered sacrifices.

bible_quanes.question: What did Jethro do after advising Moses?
bible_quanes.answer: Went his way into his own land
bible_quanes.explanation: Moses let him depart.

bible_quanes.question: In which month did Israel come to the Wilderness of Sinai?
bible_quanes.explanation: After leaving Egypt.

bible_quanes.question: What did God call Israel if they kept His covenant?
bible_quanes.answer: A peculiar treasure unto Him above all people
bible_quanes.explanation: For all the earth is His.

bible_quanes.question: What else did God say Israel would be?
bible_quanes.answer: A kingdom of priests and a holy nation
bible_quanes.explanation: These were the words for Moses to speak.

bible_quanes.question: What happened on the morning of the third day at Sinai?
bible_quanes.answer: Thunders and lightnings, a thick cloud upon the mount, and the voice of the trumpet exceeding loud
bible_quanes.explanation: All the people trembled.

bible_quanes.question: How did God say He had carried Israel?
bible_quanes.explanation: He brought them to Himself.

bible_quanes.question: What did the people answer God's covenant offer?
bible_quanes.answer: "All that the LORD has spoken we will do"
bible_quanes.explanation: Moses reported their words to the LORD.

bible_quanes.question: What was the penalty for touching the mountain?
bible_quanes.explanation: Bounds were set around Sinai.

bible_quanes.question: Why was Mount Sinai covered with smoke?
bible_quanes.answer: The LORD descended on it in fire
bible_quanes.explanation: The whole mountain quaked.

bible_quanes.question: How were the people to prepare to meet God?
bible_quanes.answer: Sanctify them and let them wash their clothes
bible_quanes.explanation: To be ready by the third day.

bible_quanes.question: Who was allowed to come up with Moses after the warning?
bible_quanes.explanation: The priests and people were not to break through.

bible_quanes.question: What is the first of the Ten Commandments?
bible_quanes.answer: Thou shalt have no other gods before me
bible_quanes.explanation: The Ten Commandments begin here.

bible_quanes.question: Which day were they to remember and keep holy?
bible_quanes.explanation: The fourth commandment.

bible_quanes.question: Which commandment comes with the promise of long life in the land?
bible_quanes.answer: Honour thy father and thy mother
bible_quanes.explanation: The fifth commandment.

bible_quanes.question: What is the sixth commandment?
bible_quanes.explanation: It protects human life.

bible_quanes.question: What does the second commandment forbid?
bible_quanes.answer: Make any graven image or likeness, to bow down to them or serve them
bible_quanes.explanation: For the LORD is a jealous God.

bible_quanes.question: What does the third commandment forbid?
bible_quanes.answer: Take the name of the LORD thy God in vain
bible_quanes.explanation: The LORD will not hold such a person guiltless.

bible_quanes.question: What does the tenth commandment forbid?
bible_quanes.explanation: Your neighbour's house, wife, servants, animals or any thing that is his.

bible_quanes.question: What did the people ask Moses after hearing God speak?
bible_quanes.answer: You speak with us, but let not God speak with us, lest we die
bible_quanes.explanation: They were afraid.

bible_quanes.question: What kind of stone was forbidden for building an altar?
bible_quanes.explanation: Using a tool on it would profane it.

bible_quanes.question: What reason does Exodus 20 give for the Sabbath?
bible_quanes.answer: In six days the LORD made heaven and earth and rested on the seventh day
bible_quanes.explanation: It is rooted in creation.

bible_quanes.question: How many years did a Hebrew servant serve before going free?
bible_quanes.explanation: In the seventh he went out free.

bible_quanes.question: What was the penalty for striking a man so that he died?
bible_quanes.explanation: It was a capital offence.

bible_quanes.question: Complete the law: "Eye for eye, tooth for ..."
bible_quanes.explanation: Hand for hand, foot for foot.

bible_quanes.question: What was the penalty for striking one's father or mother?
bible_quanes.explanation: It was treated as a grave crime.

bible_quanes.question: How was a servant who chose to stay with his master marked?
bible_quanes.answer: His master shall bore his ear through with an aul
bible_quanes.explanation: He would then serve him for ever.

bible_quanes.question: Where could someone who killed a person unintentionally flee?
bible_quanes.explanation: This anticipates the cities of refuge.

bible_quanes.question: What happened to an ox that gored a person to death?
bible_quanes.explanation: Its flesh was not to be eaten.

bible_quanes.question: When was the ox's owner also held responsible?
bible_quanes.answer: If the ox was wont to push with his horn and he had not kept him in
bible_quanes.explanation: The owner could also be put to death.

bible_quanes.question: What was paid if an ox gored a servant?
bible_quanes.explanation: Paid to the servant's master.

bible_quanes.question: What was the penalty for cursing one's father or mother?
bible_quanes.explanation: A severe law protecting parents.

bible_quanes.question: What was the restitution for a stolen ox that was killed or sold?
bible_quanes.explanation: Four sheep were repaid for a sheep.

bible_quanes.question: What does Exodus 22:18 say about a sorceress?
bible_quanes.answer: Thou shalt not suffer a witch to live
bible_quanes.explanation: A law against witchcraft.

bible_quanes.question: How were strangers (foreigners) to be treated?
bible_quanes.answer: Thou shalt neither vex a stranger, nor oppress him
bible_quanes.explanation: For Israel had been strangers in Egypt.

bible_quanes.question: Who were never to be afflicted?
bible_quanes.explanation: God hears their cry.

bible_quanes.question: What was the restitution if a stolen animal was found alive with the thief?
bible_quanes.explanation: He was to restore double.

bible_quanes.question: What was forbidden when lending money to the poor?
bible_quanes.explanation: They were not to act like a moneylender.

bible_quanes.question: When must a neighbour's garment taken as a pledge be returned?
bible_quanes.answer: By that the sun goeth down
bible_quanes.explanation: It might be his only covering.

bible_quanes.question: Whom were the Israelites not to revile or curse?
bible_quanes.answer: The gods, and the ruler of thy people
bible_quanes.explanation: Respect for authority.

bible_quanes.question: What were they not to delay offering?
bible_quanes.answer: The first of thy ripe fruits, and of thy liquors
bible_quanes.explanation: And the firstborn of their sons.

bible_quanes.question: What meat were they not to eat?
bible_quanes.answer: Flesh torn by beasts in the field
bible_quanes.explanation: They were to throw it to the dogs.

bible_quanes.question: What must you not circulate?
bible_quanes.explanation: Nor join the wicked as an unrighteous witness.

bible_quanes.question: What should you do if you meet your enemy's ox going astray?
bible_quanes.explanation: A law of kindness even to enemies.

bible_quanes.question: What was done with the land in the seventh year?
bible_quanes.answer: It was to rest and lie still
bible_quanes.explanation: So the poor could eat from it.

bible_quanes.question: What did God promise to send before Israel?
bible_quanes.explanation: To keep them and bring them to the prepared place.

bible_quanes.question: What does a bribe do?
bible_quanes.answer: Blindeth the wise and perverteth the words of the righteous
bible_quanes.explanation: They were to take no bribe.

bible_quanes.question: How many times a year were they to keep a feast to the Lord?
bible_quanes.explanation: Unleavened Bread, Harvest and Ingathering.

bible_quanes.question: What was not to be boiled in its mother's milk?
bible_quanes.explanation: A distinctive prohibition.

bible_quanes.question: What would God send ahead to drive out Israel's enemies?
bible_quanes.explanation: They would drive out the Hivite, Canaanite and Hittite.

bible_quanes.question: Why would God drive out the nations little by little?
bible_quanes.answer: Lest the land become desolate and the beast of the field multiply
bible_quanes.explanation: Until Israel increased.

bible_quanes.question: What boundaries are given in Exodus 23:31?
bible_quanes.answer: From the Red Sea to the sea of the Philistines, and from the desert to the River
bible_quanes.explanation: The extent of the promised land.

bible_quanes.question: How did the people respond to the words of the LORD?
bible_quanes.answer: "All the words which the LORD has said we will do"
bible_quanes.explanation: They answered with one voice.

bible_quanes.question: What did Moses write down?
bible_quanes.answer: All the words of the LORD
bible_quanes.explanation: Then he built an altar.

bible_quanes.question: How long was Moses on the mountain?
bible_quanes.explanation: He went into the midst of the cloud.

bible_quanes.question: Who went up the mountain with Moses?
bible_quanes.explanation: Moses went up to the mountain of God.

bible_quanes.question: How many pillars did Moses set up at the altar?
bible_quanes.explanation: According to the twelve tribes.

bible_quanes.question: What did Moses sprinkle on the people?
bible_quanes.explanation: This ratified the covenant.

bible_quanes.question: What was under God's feet when the elders saw Him?
bible_quanes.answer: As it were a paved work of a sapphire stone
bible_quanes.explanation: As clear as the sky itself.

bible_quanes.question: What did the glory of the LORD look like to Israel?
bible_quanes.answer: Like devouring fire on the top of the mount
bible_quanes.explanation: It was seen by all the people.

bible_quanes.question: How many elders went up with Moses, Aaron, Nadab and Abihu?
bible_quanes.explanation: They saw the God of Israel.

bible_quanes.question: Whom did Moses leave in charge while he was away?
bible_quanes.explanation: Anyone with a dispute was to go to them.

bible_quanes.question: What did God tell Israel to make so that He could dwell among them?
bible_quanes.explanation: This became the tabernacle.

bible_quanes.question: What wood was the ark made from?
bible_quanes.explanation: It was overlaid with pure gold.

bible_quanes.question: What was placed on the ends of the mercy seat?
bible_quanes.explanation: One at each end.

bible_quanes.question: What was the candlestick made of?
bible_quanes.explanation: It was of hammered work.

bible_quanes.question: How were offerings for the sanctuary to be given?
bible_quanes.explanation: They were freewill offerings.

bible_quanes.question: What was to be put inside the ark?
bible_quanes.explanation: The tablets of the law.

bible_quanes.question: What was placed on the table before the Lord always?
bible_quanes.explanation: The bread of the Presence.

bible_quanes.question: How many lamps were on the candlestick?
bible_quanes.explanation: They were to give light in front of it.

bible_quanes.question: Where did God say He would meet with Moses?
bible_quanes.answer: Above the mercy seat, between the two cherubim
bible_quanes.explanation: From there He would speak with him.

bible_quanes.question: How was Moses to make every thing for the tabernacle?
bible_quanes.answer: After the pattern which was shewed him in the mount
bible_quanes.explanation: Hebrews 8:5 quotes this.

bible_quanes.question: How many linen curtains made up the tabernacle?
bible_quanes.explanation: Of fine woven linen with cherubim.

bible_quanes.question: What did the vail separate?
bible_quanes.answer: The holy place and the most holy
bible_quanes.explanation: It divided the inner sanctuary.

bible_quanes.question: What made up the outer coverings of the tent?
bible_quanes.answer: Ram skins dyed red and badger skins
bible_quanes.explanation: These were the top coverings.

bible_quanes.question: What were the curtains over the tabernacle tent made of?
bible_quanes.explanation: There were eleven of them.

bible_quanes.question: What was woven into the vail?
bible_quanes.explanation: In blue, purple, scarlet and fine linen.

bible_quanes.question: Where was the mercy seat placed?
bible_quanes.answer: On the ark of the Testimony in the Most Holy
bible_quanes.explanation: Behind the vail.

bible_quanes.question: Where was the candlestick placed?
bible_quanes.answer: On the south side, over against the table
bible_quanes.explanation: Outside the vail.

bible_quanes.question: What were the tabernacle boards made of?
bible_quanes.explanation: They stood upright.

bible_quanes.question: What joined the linen curtains together?
bible_quanes.explanation: So that it would be one tabernacle.

bible_quanes.question: What hung at the door of the tent?
bible_quanes.answer: An hanging of blue, purple, scarlet and fine twined linen
bible_quanes.explanation: Made by a weaver.

bible_quanes.question: What was the altar of burnt offering made of?
bible_quanes.explanation: It was overlaid with brass.

bible_quanes.question: What surrounded the tabernacle?
bible_quanes.explanation: With hangings of fine linen.

bible_quanes.question: What oil was used for the lamp?
bible_quanes.answer: Pure oil olive beaten for the light
bible_quanes.explanation: To make the lamp burn continually.

bible_quanes.question: What was on the four corners of the altar?
bible_quanes.explanation: Made of one piece with it.

bible_quanes.question: What were the dimensions of the altar of burnt offering?
bible_quanes.answer: Five cubits long, five cubits broad, foursquare, and three cubits the height
bible_quanes.explanation: It was square.

bible_quanes.question: What was made for the altar?
bible_quanes.answer: A grate of network of brass
bible_quanes.explanation: With four brass rings at its corners.

bible_quanes.question: What were the dimensions of the court?
bible_quanes.answer: The length an hundred cubits and the breadth fifty
bible_quanes.explanation: With hangings five cubits high.

bible_quanes.question: Who was to tend the lamp?
bible_quanes.explanation: From evening until morning.

bible_quanes.question: How wide was the screen at the gate of the court?
bible_quanes.explanation: Woven of blue, purple, scarlet and fine linen.

bible_quanes.question: What were the tabernacle pegs made of?
bible_quanes.explanation: As were all its utensils.

bible_quanes.question: Who were to minister to God as priests?
bible_quanes.explanation: They were set apart from among Israel.

bible_quanes.question: What was placed in the breastplate of judgment?
bible_quanes.explanation: They were over Aaron's heart.

bible_quanes.question: What was engraved on the gold plate on the priest's mitre?
bible_quanes.explanation: It was worn on his forehead.

bible_quanes.question: Why were holy garments made for Aaron?
bible_quanes.explanation: Made by gifted artisans.

bible_quanes.question: Name the garments made for the high priest.
bible_quanes.answer: A breastplate, an ephod, a robe, a broidered coat, a mitre and a girdle
bible_quanes.explanation: Six items are listed.

bible_quanes.question: What was engraved on the two onyx stones?
bible_quanes.answer: The names of the children of Israel, six names on one stone
bible_quanes.explanation: They were worn on the shoulders.

bible_quanes.question: How many stones were in the breastplate?
bible_quanes.explanation: One for each tribe.

bible_quanes.question: What was attached around the hem of the robe?
bible_quanes.explanation: Alternating.

bible_quanes.question: Why were bells put on the high priest's robe?
bible_quanes.answer: That his sound shall be heard in the holy place, that he die not
bible_quanes.explanation: When he went in and came out.

bible_quanes.question: What colour was the robe of the ephod?
bible_quanes.explanation: It was woven work.

bible_quanes.question: What was done first to Aaron and his sons at their consecration?
bible_quanes.answer: Thou shalt wash them with water
bible_quanes.explanation: At the door of the tabernacle.

bible_quanes.question: What was poured on Aaron's head?
bible_quanes.explanation: To consecrate him.

bible_quanes.question: What was offered on the altar every day?
bible_quanes.answer: Two lambs of the first year
bible_quanes.explanation: One in the morning and one at twilight.

bible_quanes.question: What did God promise to do among Israel?
bible_quanes.answer: Dwell among them and be their God
bible_quanes.explanation: A promise of His presence.

bible_quanes.question: Where was the blood of the ram of consecration put?
bible_quanes.answer: On the tip of the right ear, the right thumb and the right big toe
bible_quanes.explanation: Of Aaron and his sons.

bible_quanes.question: How many days did the priests' consecration last?
bible_quanes.explanation: They were consecrated each day.

bible_quanes.question: What happened to whatever touched the altar?
bible_quanes.explanation: The altar was most holy.

bible_quanes.question: Where did Aaron and his sons lay their hands?
bible_quanes.answer: On the head of the bullock
bible_quanes.explanation: Identifying with the sacrifice.

bible_quanes.question: What is called a continual burnt offering throughout their generations?
bible_quanes.answer: The burnt offering at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation
bible_quanes.explanation: Where God would meet with them.

bible_quanes.question: Why did God say He brought Israel out of Egypt in Exodus 29:46?
bible_quanes.answer: That He may dwell among them
bible_quanes.explanation: They would know He is the LORD their God.

bible_quanes.question: What altar was made for burning incense?
bible_quanes.explanation: Overlaid with pure gold.

bible_quanes.question: When did Aaron burn sweet incense?
bible_quanes.answer: Every morning when he dresseth the lamps
bible_quanes.explanation: When he tended the lamps.

bible_quanes.question: What brass vessel was made for washing?
bible_quanes.explanation: Placed between the tabernacle and the altar.

bible_quanes.question: What was each person counted in the census to give?
bible_quanes.explanation: As a ransom for himself.

bible_quanes.question: Did the rich give more than the poor?
bible_quanes.answer: No; the rich shall not give more, and the poor shall not give less than half a shekel
bible_quanes.explanation: Each gave half a shekel.

bible_quanes.question: What did Aaron and his sons wash at the laver?
bible_quanes.explanation: Lest they die.

bible_quanes.question: What was made from spices and olive oil?
bible_quanes.explanation: Made by the art of the perfumer.

bible_quanes.question: How often was atonement made on the horns of the incense altar?
bible_quanes.explanation: With the blood of the sin offering.

bible_quanes.question: Name one spice used in the holy anointing oil.
bible_quanes.answer: Pure myrrh (also sweet cinnamon, sweet calamus and cassia)
bible_quanes.explanation: With a hin of olive oil.

bible_quanes.question: Name one spice used in the holy incense.
bible_quanes.explanation: Equal amounts of each.

bible_quanes.question: Whom did God call by name to craft the tabernacle?
bible_quanes.explanation: The son of Uri.

bible_quanes.question: Who was appointed to help Bezaleel?
bible_quanes.explanation: Of the tribe of Dan.

bible_quanes.question: What did God give Moses on Mount Sinai?
bible_quanes.answer: Two tables of testimony, written with the finger of God
bible_quanes.explanation: Tablets of stone.

bible_quanes.question: What was a sign between God and Israel?
bible_quanes.explanation: Throughout their generations.

bible_quanes.question: From which tribe was Bezaleel?
bible_quanes.explanation: He was the son of Uri, son of Hur.

bible_quanes.question: With what did God fill Bezaleel?
bible_quanes.explanation: In wisdom, understanding and knowledge.

bible_quanes.question: What was the penalty for profaning the Sabbath?
bible_quanes.explanation: That person would be cut off.

bible_quanes.question: What does Exodus 31:17 say God did on the seventh day?
bible_quanes.explanation: The Sabbath recalls creation.

bible_quanes.question: How were the stone tables written?
bible_quanes.explanation: They were tables of the Testimony.

bible_quanes.question: Who was Aholiab's father?
bible_quanes.explanation: Of the tribe of Dan.

bible_quanes.question: What did Aaron make while Moses was on the mountain?
bible_quanes.explanation: From the people's gold earrings.

bible_quanes.question: What did Moses do with the tables when he saw the calf?
bible_quanes.answer: Cast them out of his hands and brake them beneath the mount
bible_quanes.explanation: His anger burned.

bible_quanes.question: What did Moses do with the golden calf?
bible_quanes.answer: Burnt it, ground it to powder, strawed it upon the water and made Israel drink of it
bible_quanes.explanation: He destroyed the idol.

bible_quanes.question: Which tribe gathered to Moses' side?
bible_quanes.explanation: In answer to "Whoever is on the LORD's side."

bible_quanes.question: Why did the people ask Aaron to make them gods?
bible_quanes.answer: Moses delayed to come down out of the mount
bible_quanes.explanation: They did not know what had become of him.

bible_quanes.question: What did Aaron proclaim after building an altar before the calf?
bible_quanes.answer: "To morrow is a feast to the LORD"
bible_quanes.explanation: He mixed idolatry with worship.

bible_quanes.question: What excuse did Aaron give Moses?
bible_quanes.answer: He cast the gold into the fire, and there came out this calf
bible_quanes.explanation: A weak excuse.

bible_quanes.question: About how many men died that day?
bible_quanes.explanation: At the hands of the Levites.

bible_quanes.question: What did Moses ask God concerning Israel's sin?
bible_quanes.answer: Forgive their sin; and if not, blot me out of thy book
bible_quanes.explanation: A great act of intercession.

bible_quanes.question: What did Moses appeal to when interceding for Israel?
bible_quanes.answer: Wherefore should the Egyptians speak, and remember Abraham, Isaac and Israel
bible_quanes.explanation: God relented from the harm.

bible_quanes.question: How did the LORD speak to Moses?
bible_quanes.answer: Face to face, as a man speaketh unto his friend
bible_quanes.explanation: In the tabernacle of the congregation.

bible_quanes.question: What did Moses ask to see?
bible_quanes.explanation: "Please, shew me Your glory."

bible_quanes.question: Why could Moses not see God's face?
bible_quanes.answer: No man can see His face and live
bible_quanes.explanation: God protected him.

bible_quanes.question: What did God promise Moses in Exodus 33:14?
bible_quanes.answer: "My Presence will go with you, and I will give you rest"
bible_quanes.explanation: A comforting promise.

bible_quanes.question: What did Moses call the tent he pitched outside the camp?
bible_quanes.explanation: Anyone who sought the LORD went there.

bible_quanes.question: Who did not depart from the tabernacle of the congregation?
bible_quanes.explanation: Moses' young assistant.

bible_quanes.question: Where did God put Moses as His glory passed by?
bible_quanes.answer: In a clift of the rock
bible_quanes.explanation: God covered him with His hand.

bible_quanes.question: What did Moses see of God?
bible_quanes.explanation: Not His face.

bible_quanes.question: What did the Israelites take off at Mount Horeb?
bible_quanes.explanation: As a sign of mourning.

bible_quanes.question: What did God say about His mercy in Exodus 33:19?
bible_quanes.answer: "I will be gracious to whom I will be gracious"
bible_quanes.explanation: Paul quotes this in Romans 9:15.

bible_quanes.question: What did God tell Moses to cut out?
bible_quanes.answer: Two tables of stone like unto the first
bible_quanes.explanation: God would write on them again.

bible_quanes.question: How long was Moses with the LORD this time?
bible_quanes.explanation: He neither ate bread nor drank water.

bible_quanes.question: What happened to Moses' face?
bible_quanes.explanation: He did not know it.

bible_quanes.question: What did Moses put on his face?
bible_quanes.explanation: When he finished speaking with the people.

bible_quanes.question: How did the LORD proclaim Himself to Moses?
bible_quanes.answer: Merciful and gracious, longsuffering, and abundant in goodness and truth
bible_quanes.explanation: He proclaimed His name as He passed by.

bible_quanes.question: What does Exodus 34:14 say God's name is?
bible_quanes.explanation: He is a jealous God.

bible_quanes.question: What were they to destroy in Canaan?
bible_quanes.answer: Their altars, their images and their groves
bible_quanes.explanation: Of the people of the land.

bible_quanes.question: How were they not to appear before the Lord?
bible_quanes.explanation: They were to bring an offering.

bible_quanes.question: To which generations does God visit the iniquity of the fathers?
bible_quanes.explanation: Yet He keeps mercy for thousands.

bible_quanes.question: Why were Aaron and the people afraid to come near Moses?
bible_quanes.answer: The skin of his face shone
bible_quanes.explanation: He had spoken with God.

bible_quanes.question: On how many days was work to be done?
bible_quanes.explanation: The seventh was a holy Sabbath.

bible_quanes.question: What were they not to kindle on the Sabbath?
bible_quanes.explanation: Throughout their dwellings.

bible_quanes.question: Who brought offerings for the tabernacle?
bible_quanes.answer: Every one whose heart stirred him up, and every one whom his spirit made willing
bible_quanes.explanation: Freewill offerings.

bible_quanes.question: Whom did Moses announce the LORD had called by name?
bible_quanes.explanation: The son of Uri.

bible_quanes.question: Which metals were requested for the offering?
bible_quanes.explanation: Among other materials.

bible_quanes.question: What did both men and women bring?
bible_quanes.answer: Bracelets, earrings, rings and tablets, all jewels of gold
bible_quanes.explanation: Jewelry of gold.

bible_quanes.question: What did the skilled women do?
bible_quanes.explanation: Blue, purple, scarlet and fine linen.

bible_quanes.question: What ability did God put in the hearts of Bezaleel and Aholiab?
bible_quanes.explanation: They could teach others the crafts.

bible_quanes.question: What did the rulers bring?
bible_quanes.answer: Onyx stones and stones to be set in the ephod and breastplate
bible_quanes.explanation: Along with spices and oil.

bible_quanes.question: How is the people's giving described in Exodus 35:29?
bible_quanes.answer: A willing offering unto the LORD
bible_quanes.explanation: From all whose hearts were willing.

bible_quanes.question: What did the workers tell Moses about the offerings?
bible_quanes.answer: The people were bringing much more than enough
bible_quanes.explanation: There was an excess.

bible_quanes.question: What did Moses command after hearing this?
bible_quanes.answer: Let neither man nor woman make any more work for the offering
bible_quanes.explanation: The people were restrained from bringing.

bible_quanes.question: Who made the ten curtains of the tabernacle?
bible_quanes.answer: Every wise hearted man that wrought the work
bible_quanes.explanation: Of fine woven linen with cherubim.

bible_quanes.question: Who worked on the sanctuary?
bible_quanes.answer: Bezaleel, Aholiab and every wise hearted man
bible_quanes.explanation: Those in whom God put wisdom.

bible_quanes.question: How often did the people bring freewill offerings?
bible_quanes.explanation: They kept bringing more.

bible_quanes.question: How much material was there for the work?
bible_quanes.answer: Sufficient for all the work, and too much
bible_quanes.explanation: More than enough.

bible_quanes.question: What was woven into the vail made by the artisans in Exodus 36?
bible_quanes.explanation: With artistic designs.

bible_quanes.question: What wood were the tabernacle boards made of?
bible_quanes.explanation: Standing upright.

bible_quanes.question: How many curtains of goats' hair were made?
bible_quanes.explanation: For the tent over the tabernacle.

bible_quanes.question: What overlaid the capitals of the door pillars?
bible_quanes.explanation: Their five sockets were brass.

bible_quanes.question: Who made the ark?
bible_quanes.explanation: Of shittim wood.

bible_quanes.question: What did Bezaleel make on the ends of the mercy seat?
bible_quanes.explanation: Of hammered work.

bible_quanes.question: What did Bezaleel make of pure hammered gold?
bible_quanes.explanation: With its shaft, branches and bowls.

bible_quanes.question: Which altar did Bezaleel make of shittim wood overlaid with gold?
bible_quanes.explanation: It was square.

bible_quanes.question: What were the dimensions of the ark?
bible_quanes.answer: Two cubits and a half the length, a cubit and a half the breadth, a cubit and a half the height
bible_quanes.explanation: Made of shittim wood.

bible_quanes.question: How did the cherubim on the mercy seat face?
bible_quanes.answer: With their faces one to another, to the mercy seatward
bible_quanes.explanation: With wings spread out above.

bible_quanes.question: What table did Bezaleel make?
bible_quanes.explanation: For the showbread.

bible_quanes.question: How many lamps did the candlestick have?
bible_quanes.explanation: With wick-trimmers and trays of gold.

bible_quanes.question: How much gold was used for the candlestick and its utensils?
bible_quanes.explanation: For the candlestick and all its utensils.

bible_quanes.question: What else did Bezaleel make besides the furnishings?
bible_quanes.answer: The holy anointing oil and pure incense
bible_quanes.explanation: According to the work of the perfumer.

bible_quanes.question: What did Bezaleel overlay the altar of burnt offering with?
bible_quanes.explanation: Five cubits square.

bible_quanes.question: From what was the brass laver made?
bible_quanes.answer: The lookingglasses of the women assembling at the door of the tabernacle
bible_quanes.explanation: Who assembled at the door of the tabernacle.

bible_quanes.question: Who made all that the LORD commanded Moses?
bible_quanes.explanation: Of the tribe of Judah.

bible_quanes.question: Who worked with Bezaleel?
bible_quanes.explanation: An engraver, designer and weaver.

bible_quanes.question: What were the hangings of the court made of?
bible_quanes.explanation: One hundred cubits on the south side.

bible_quanes.question: Who did the accounting for the tabernacle materials?
bible_quanes.answer: The Levites, by the hand of Ithamar, son to Aaron
bible_quanes.explanation: By the command of Moses.

bible_quanes.question: How much gold was used in the work?
bible_quanes.explanation: For the work of the holy place.

bible_quanes.question: How many men were counted in the census for the half-shekel?
bible_quanes.answer: Six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty
bible_quanes.explanation: Twenty years old and above.

bible_quanes.question: How many sockets were made from 100 talents of silver?
bible_quanes.explanation: One talent for each socket.

bible_quanes.question: How much brass was offered?
bible_quanes.answer: Seventy talents and two thousand and four hundred shekels
bible_quanes.explanation: Used for the altar, sockets and pegs.

bible_quanes.question: From what threads were the holy garments made?
bible_quanes.explanation: As the LORD commanded Moses.

bible_quanes.question: What was written on the plate of the holy crown?
bible_quanes.explanation: Like the engraving of a signet.

bible_quanes.question: What did Moses do after inspecting the finished work?
bible_quanes.explanation: It had been done as the LORD commanded.

bible_quanes.question: What was finished in Exodus 39:32?
bible_quanes.answer: All the work of the tabernacle
bible_quanes.explanation: Israel did all the LORD commanded.

bible_quanes.question: How was the gold thread for the ephod made?
bible_quanes.answer: They beat the gold into thin plates and cut it into wires
bible_quanes.explanation: Then worked into the fabric.

bible_quanes.question: In what were the onyx stones set?
bible_quanes.explanation: Engraved with the names of Israel's sons.

bible_quanes.question: How many rows of stones were in the breastplate?
bible_quanes.explanation: Three stones in each row.

bible_quanes.question: What alternated around the hem of the robe?
bible_quanes.explanation: All around the hem.

bible_quanes.question: To whom did the people bring the finished tabernacle?
bible_quanes.explanation: For his inspection.

bible_quanes.question: How did Israel do all the work?
bible_quanes.answer: According to all that the LORD had commanded Moses
bible_quanes.explanation: They were faithful to the pattern.

bible_quanes.question: On what day was the tabernacle to be set up?
bible_quanes.answer: The first day of the first month
bible_quanes.explanation: A new beginning.

bible_quanes.question: What covered the tabernacle of the congregation when it was finished?
bible_quanes.explanation: The glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle.

bible_quanes.question: Could Moses enter the tabernacle when the glory filled it?
bible_quanes.explanation: The cloud rested on it and the glory filled it.

bible_quanes.question: What was over the tabernacle by night?
bible_quanes.explanation: The cloud was over it by day.

bible_quanes.question: In which year after the Exodus was the tabernacle raised?
bible_quanes.explanation: On the first day of the first month.

bible_quanes.question: What did Moses put into the ark?
bible_quanes.explanation: Then he put the mercy seat on top.

bible_quanes.question: When did Israel set out on their journeys?
bible_quanes.answer: When the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle
bible_quanes.explanation: God guided their travels.

bible_quanes.question: What kind of priesthood did the anointing of Aaron's sons bring?
bible_quanes.explanation: Throughout their generations.

bible_quanes.question: What final act finished the work?
bible_quanes.answer: He set up the hanging of the court gate
bible_quanes.explanation: So Moses finished the work.

bible_quanes.question: What did Israel do if the cloud was not taken up?
bible_quanes.answer: They journeyed not till the day it was taken up
bible_quanes.explanation: They waited on God's leading.
